summary: Batch A tests. iOS (one simulator, serial): full-suite run stalled after 321 of 325 classes; the 4 never-run classes (AccountViewModelLoadSubscriptionCacheClobberRegressionTests, CallControllerTranscriptionToastTests, StoreKitManagerPurchaseSyncFailureTests, TranscriptRelayControllerTests) hang identically on the untouched base (pre-existing). 40 failures logged; 23 also fail on the base (PendingInvite*, MessageGroupRowBaseline, divider-removal pins, etc., pre-existing); 17 were source-pin tests for the old markup (Pad/AuthView gating, keyboard-dismiss, Submenu follow-up and visual-redesign pins) and were updated to pin the new FSForm kit; 2 timing-sensitive tests (CallControllerSummarize, NetworkService beacon) passed on rerun. FSFormKitTests 6/6, SubmenuVisualRedesign all pass. Web vitest: 49 failed / 2009 passed, identical failing file set to the untouched base (recharts/dockview/AppNav/build-only tests are environment-related); Account.redesign is load-flaky (passes alone and in the second full run).
